# WorldAtlas

> > Comprehensive geography reference resource providing maps, country data, and educational content about continents, nations, and global geography.

WorldAtlas is operated by Reunion Technology Inc. and led by geography experts including John Moen, Chris Woolwine-Moen, and editorial contributors like Oishimaya Sen Nag and Marek Brys. The platform serves as an educational resource for students, educators, and geography enthusiasts worldwide.

## Key Topics

- World Geography
- Country Maps and Flags
- Continents (Asia, Africa, Europe, Australia, Antarctica, Americas)
- Cartography and Geographic Data
- ISO Country Codes
- Population and GDP Statistics
- US States and Postal Codes
- Educational Geography Resources
- Geography Publishing
- Geographic Reference Data

## Geographic Reference

- [List of Maps with Flags and Country Codes](https://www.worldatlas.com/maps): Complete country reference: flags, ISO codes, dialing codes, GDP, population
- [Continents Of The World](https://www.worldatlas.com/continents): Overview of 7 continents: Asia, Africa, Americas, Europe, Australia, Antarctica
- [USA States (Two-Letter Abbreviations)](https://www.worldatlas.com/geography/usa-states.html): US state abbreviations, USPS postal codes, and ZIP code reference

## About WorldAtlas

- [About Us - WorldAtlas](https://www.worldatlas.com/about): About WorldAtlas, its history, and team including John Moen and founders
- [WorldAtlas.com](https://www.worldatlas.com/about.htm): WorldAtlas company info and editorial team directory
